environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.11 runtime) deployed with default configuration. API Gateway with IAM authorization, but the invoking role is shared across 14 internal microservices. Lambda has execution role with AmazonS3FullAccess, AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess, and AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole. Function runs in default Lambda sandbox with /tmp writable (512MB). No VPC attachment, function has outbound internet access via Lambda service NAT.
